timings.totals_note: Parent totals include child stages. Do not sum all keys; other includes cleanup, scheduling and instrumentation overhead. Optional or reused stages are zero.

parameters.below_rule: dy > 0 and degrees(atan2(abs(dx), dy)) <= max_angle_from_downward_degrees; processing image coordinates
